items.description: Young people in Nepal are seeking international solidarity from COP31 to help our nation tackle the worsening climate disasters knocking at all of our doors The post Nepal’s climate suffering should pave the way for a safe and fair future appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: We must strengthen trade cooperation to deliver on global climate goals
items.description: As governments turn to trade-related measures to deliver on their climate targets, cooperation is vital to reduce fragmentation, costs and build more resilient economies The post We must strengthen trade cooperation to deliver on global climate goals appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: Ukraine updates: EU to send united front to potential peace talks
items.description: Germany, France, the UK, Italy and Poland — as well as the EU itself — will jointly represent Europe in possible peace talks. Meanwhile, a second car bomb in two days has exploded in Moscow. DW has more.

items.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
items.description: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Germany news: Parliament agrees on debt-laden 2027 budget
items.description: The budget committee in the Bundestag worked into the night to sign off on next year's spending plans. These include levels of new debt only eclipsed once, at the height of the COVID pandemic. DW has more.

items.title: The dangers of revising Europe's security architecture
items.description: Experts warn against revising Europe's security framework because they say it would mean granting Moscow its longstanding wish of renegotiating postwar security on the continent.

items.title: EU leaders urged to 'act now' to stay AI competitive with US, China
items.description: EU leaders in Dublin were called on by an AI executive to move quickly in the tech race with the US and China. EU official Metsola, however, expressed frustration with the idea that the bloc is behind in AI development.
